changelog: Adds personal F6 controls and a native per-player glider-flight candidate for supported dedicated servers. Older providers return an explicit unsupported result.
Separates upward gliding from unlimited glider stamina. Restores original game values when the mod is disabled.

toggleUpwardGliding.label: Toggle Upward Gliding
toggleUpwardGliding.description: Press F6 to toggle this runtime's Upward Gliding setting. Assign another shortcut in Compatibility → Hotkeys.

unlimitedFlying.label: Upward Gliding
unlimitedFlying.description: Allows the glider to tilt upward while glider stamina depletes normally.

turnSpeed.label: Turn Speed
turnSpeed.description: Multiplier for the glider's turning speed.

moveSpeed.label: Move Speed
moveSpeed.description: Multiplier for the glider's forward acceleration.

liftSpeed.label: Lift Speed
liftSpeed.description: Multiplier for the glider's longitudinal air resistance. Higher values increase drag.

descendSpeed.label: Descend Speed
descendSpeed.description: Multiplier for the glider's vertical air resistance. Higher values increase drag.

groups.label: Unlimited Flight
groups.description: Speed changes affect the active glider and every player using the same glider type.
